blocks.text: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) aam taur par bacteria se hoti hain, sab se zyada Escherichia coli se. Yeh bacteria urethra ke raste urinary system mein dakhil hote hain aur bladder, ureters ya gurdon mein infection kar dete hain.

UTI ki alamaat (symptoms): baar baar aur fauran peshab ki hajat, peshab karte waqt dard ya jalan, dhundla ya tez boo wala peshab, pait ke nichle hisse mein dard, aur kabhi bukhar ya kapkapi (chills). Ilaj mein bimari paida karne wale bacteria ko marne ke liye antibiotics ka poora course diya jata hai. Zyada pani peena aur baar baar peshab karna bhi bacteria ko baha kar nikalne aur alamaat kam karne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.prompt: UTI mein zyada pani peena kyun madad deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada pani se zyada peshab aur baar baar peshab hota hai, jo antibiotics ke saath bacteria ko peshab ki nali se baha deta hai.

items: UTI: bacteria (zyada tar Escherichia coli) urethra se dakhil ho kar bladder, ureters ya gurdon mein infection karte hain.
Alamaat: baar baar peshab ki hajat, jalan, dhundla peshab, pait mein dard, kabhi bukhar.
Ilaj: antibiotics ka course, zyada pani aur baar baar peshab.
